versions.content: If the underlying EEPROM technology requires a certain align- ment of the read address or length information and if the address and/or length pa- rameter for a read or compare Job are not correctly aligned, the function Eep_Main- Function shall internally compensate for this missing alignment, that is the function Eep_MainFunction shall provide byte-wise read access to the flash memory, regard- less of any alignment restrictions imposed by the Hardware.
